GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2020-10-27T01:47:11Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Crash while playing HLS live content (probably a playlist update retry process)
Description: In exoplayer 2.10.6

I am having trouble with a crashing phenomenon while playing live content on HLS.

It was crashing in the part of the playlist where I was getting an I/O (HTTP) error and retrying to get the playlist update.

I suspect the crash is caused by the fact that the process of updating currentTask is not thread-safe.

I think that if <Loader#startLoading> is called between <Loader.LoadTask#finish> and <Loader.LoadTask#start> in <Loader.LoadTask#handleMessage>, it will be like this.

Is this working as designed?
